facts.fact: Dawan Africa reports that SIMAD University laid the foundation stone on 5 November 2026 for a building to host Somalia's National AI Hub, with the communications minister, built by Hadiid Group, to offer AI research and training on building AI-powered systems.

SOM.note: No startup law, strategy, labelling or fund stated.

facts.fact: Dawan Africa reports that the SIMAD AI Institute in Mogadishu already runs training programmes, an AI and robotics lab and an innovation hub, with no startup incubation cohort stated.
